facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Commission issued a guidance notice dated 26 June 2026 requiring certified Data Protection Officers to earn at least 20 of 40 CPD points a year to stay verified under the Nigeria Data Protection Act 2023 and GAID 2025.

NGA.note: No ruling against a named organisation stated.

facts.fact: The Nigeria Data Protection Commission's notice of 26 June 2026 applies section 32 of the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023, which requires controllers of major importance to designate a Data Protection Officer.
The notice is issued under Schedule 3 of the General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2025, made under the Nigeria Data Protection Act.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission is acting under the Act: it issued the notice, verifies DPOs against its database and will set up a digital system to monitor their CPD.
The Commission issued guidance on Data Protection Officer assessment and annual CPD points, with temporary inactive status for non-compliance, and no decision against a controller is stated.
The Commission's 26 June 2026 notice applies section 32 of the Nigeria Data Protection Act, 2023 and GAID 2025 to Data Protection Officers.
The Nigeria Data Protection Commission is acting as the body administering the Act, issuing notices and verifying Data Protection Officers.
The Commission issued guidance on 26 June 2026 setting a CPD points regime for verified Data Protection Officers, and keeps a database in which DPOs are enrolled.

NGA.note: No online consultation or portal stated.
Points for DPOs contributing to consultations are named, with no consultation held.
